title: Verify and document the versioned scorecard app end to end
description: Acceptance milestone covering migration, GraphQL contracts, restart/idempotency, interactive and replay cycles, joint requests, immutable labels/explanations, version comparison/revert, reachable classifier Save buttons, drawers and full-viewport tablet UX. All automated tests fake clients/no keys; browser test real deployed local app in desktop and iPad-sized viewports with no fabricated human votes. Verify timeline requests/responses and calibration snapshots through API/storage/UI, and Play/seek/zoom/pan. Preserve existing Anthus v1/v2 data; document what is implemented versus remaining. Publish concise usage/model/versioning/metrics/calibration semantics and operator recovery instructions. No promise calibration or accuracy always improves; compare on matched eligible evidence. User live labeling remains resumable and no paid run begins merely to view UI.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Removed the redundant compact cycle grid from the playback workspace. It consumed only newly streamed events while the real recorded vis-timeline loaded history separately, incorrectly claiming no cycles in completed runs. Regression was observed failing before implementation; all 109 UI tests and build pass. Browser verified synthetic run shows three recorded cycles in the single interactive timeline, without the false empty state; no console errors. Screenshot var/web/single-history-timeline-proof.jpg. No labels or provider calls changed. React review retained the existing history-loading boundary instead of adding an unbounded duplicate history fetch. Existing unrelated effect lint warnings remain unchanged.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Fixed classifier-history route persistence: Inspect classifier now binds the frozen run member to classifier=<id> in the app URL. Reload, view changes and Back/Forward restore it; unknown IDs canonicalize via replacement and never load unrelated history. Four regression specs were observed failing before implementation; all 117 UI specs and production build now pass. Browser verified separate offline fixture tab selection, reload and Back with matching iframe history IDs; no console errors, votes or model work. Existing broad acceptance remains open. Experiment reporting remains explicitly deferred.
